# generated by tools/crosscheck.py gen - expected values come from the ROM data
symbols flashback.noi

echo self-test mode: button 1 is held at boot so the ROM runs its
echo diagnostics instead of going straight to the intro
hold 1
run 30
hold none
expect self_test == 1 w1

echo game logic: the ported interpreter replays the recorded demo and is
echo compared with the original engine frame by frame
waituntil logic_frame >= 505 12000
run 5
expect logic_frames_ok >= 504
expect logic_first_bad == 504
expect logic_bad_op == 0 w1

echo boot: level object tables are built, then the logos cutscene (0x40) starts
waituntil fmv_tick >= 2 900
run 10
expect game_state == 0 w1
expect fmv_active == 1 w1
expect is_pal == 0 w1
expectvdp display 1
waituntil fmv_tick >= 348 2000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_40_348.ppm
print fmv_tick
waituntil fmv_tick >= 677 2000
screenshot shots/sms/cut_40_677.ppm
print fmv_tick

echo timing: after 1200 real frames of the intro the stream is still in sync (bounded lag)
waituntil fmv_tick >= 518 1500
expect ticks_behind <= 48
run 60
expect ticks_behind <= 48
expect fmv_active == 1 w1
print fmv_tick

echo logos play to their natural end: 818 ticks, 592 uploads (host decode)
waituntil game_state == 1 3000 w1
expect last_clip_ticks == 818
expect last_clip_uploads == 592

echo the intro ends at the title screen
waituntil game_state == 1 3000 w1
run 5
expectvdp display 1
expectcolors 8
screenshot shots/sms/title.ppm

echo game logic: each level's live object table is built on the Z80 and
echo compared with the original engine (object count, active objects, checksum)
waituntil pge_loaded == 7 900 w1
expect 0xC023 == 107
expect 0xC015 == 26
expect 0xC007 == 47901
expect 0xC025 == 255
expect 0xC017 == 68
expect 0xC009 == 48975
expect 0xC027 == 176
expect 0xC019 == 43
expect 0xC00B == 41147
expect 0xC029 == 190
expect 0xC01B == 56
expect 0xC00D == 26003
expect 0xC02B == 90
expect 0xC01D == 29
expect 0xC00F == 39710
expect 0xC02D == 109
expect 0xC01F == 43
expect 0xC011 == 65524
expect 0xC02F == 169
expect 0xC021 == 65
expect 0xC013 == 31563
